about_the_game:
In this classic Investigative Mystery style game, you play as retired Saint Cloud City Detective Max Sterling PI.

With a lighter than usual workload, resulting in increased outings at the local bar, Max, and especially his secretary, are eager to jump on the prospects of a new job. Once tasked for answers, be sure to speak with friends, family members, business associates and even any random person willing to talk. In a world where everyone has a story, make sure to listen very carefully. You'll want to collect, examine, compare, inspect and verify as much evidence as possible. Explore the city of Saint Cloud by visiting numerous locations, including Mr. Grady's house and business, family condos, emergency buildings, other family-owned businesses, shipping docks, an airport and many other locations, including of course, a bar.

In this immersive private investigator experience, you set the pace of the game. By speaking with characters, visiting locations, and examining pieces of evidence, you'll unlock new people, places and items. Once unlocked, you decide who to interview and in what order, which places to investigate and when you want to go. Utilize all tools available to piece together and solve this complex web of lies, secrets clubs, bad business deals, ill-willed family members, and many other nefarious plans and actions. Do YOU have what it takes to crack the case?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains references to several criminal activities, including references to murder.  Also contains references to alcohol and tobacco use.  May be inappropriate for some audiences.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VRAM 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 2.0 Stereo output (44.1 kHz) 16-bit
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Window 11 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VRAM 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 2.0 Stereo output (48 kHz) 16-bit

short_description: In this classic Investigative Mystery game, you are hired to find the truth behind Mr. Grady's untimely death. Explore 40+ areas, compile a multitude of evidence, and interview over 30 unique characters to assist you in your search for answers. Do YOU have what it takes to crack the case?
